p6_co_leaching.mechanism: Co dissolution during acid washing destabilises the perovskite lattice, so more Co doping makes the A-site Sr leach out together with Co.
p6_co_leaching.relation: B-site (Co) dissolution breaks the corner-sharing BO6 network; A-site Sr2+ is then exposed and leaches in acid
p6_co_leaching.source: Seitz et al., Science 353, 1011 (2016) (SrIrO3/IrOx surface Sr leaching); Hong et al., Energy Environ. Sci. 8, 1404 (2015)

p6_sr_suppression.mechanism: Co doping strengthens the metal-oxygen framework and suppresses Sr leaching from the perovskite.
p6_sr_suppression.relation: stronger B-O covalency raises the A-site leaching barrier; retained Sr/Ir rises with doping
p6_sr_suppression.source: Grimaud et al., Nat. Energy 2, 16189 (2016) (covalency and perovskite stability in OER)
